items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: The best guitar? Well you take like Joe Moreri, that was one of the stars around here

ctx.x: Who were the best guitar players you liked to work with?
The best guitar? Well you take like Joe Moreri, that was one of the stars around here, you know what I mean? And I said the fellas used to-
He played banjo most of those days?
